g.text: app-media-server - Recording Pipeline and RTSP Relay
run() reconnects indefinitely until stop is requested.
Every attempt creates a fresh CameraPipeline and a unique
recording filename prefix, then polls for ERROR or EOS.
sampling: queue -> decode -> convert/scale -> RGB appsink
Failed EOS finalization marks open records as interrupted.
Each /live/{camera_id} mount owns a shared RTSP media factory.
Its relay pipeline opens a separate upstream RTSP connection;
it is independent from the recording CameraPipeline.
